name: Home layout — hide / show a block
where: home.html:blockHidden/frame/blocksHTML, home.html act() blk-hide and blk-show
evidence: drove it — Customise this screen, Hide on Recent, left edit mode, reloaded: the block is still away and lk_homeLayout.hidden carries "blk:recent": true; Show puts the five recent rows back

name: Nutrition card (Fuel bridge)
gap: The cycle half is built: a FUEL card on cycle.html shows the phase's food guidance and the percentage, and a switch writes lk_mcFuelAdjust — false when off, and when on an object carrying { on, updated, phase, day, cycleLen, discreet, kcalPct, fuel, train, guide, source }. fuel.html and train.html have to read it; neither file is in this package. Contract in the report.
evidence: drove it — seed cycle reads Day 12 follicular, kcalPct 0; with lastStart 2026-08-25 it reads Day 16 luteal, +5% on today's calorie target, and Home's cycle row says Day 16 Luteal from the same calculator. The switch survives a reload and puts the key back to false when turned off.

name: Cloud backup toggle (opt-in health-data sync)
gap: The local half is built: a Back this log up switch in the cycle settings sheet, storing the decision on lk_mcProfile.cloudBackup, naming exactly what would leave the device and saying that no server is configured so nothing has been uploaded. Still needed: the server (Supabase at cutover) and, before it, the sync honouring the switch — store.js SYNC_KEYS already carries lk_mcProfile, lk_mcDays and lk_mcFuelAdjust, so as written cloud.js would upload the cycle log whatever this switch says. store.js and cloud.js are not in this package.
where: cycle.html settingsSheet cs-cloud, cycle.html act() cs-cloud
evidence: drove it — toggling writes lk_mcProfile.cloudBackup and toasts "Recorded. Nothing has been uploaded — no server is configured in this build."

name: Non-female gate screen
gap: The gate is the reader's own lk_cycle switch rather than lk_profile.sex, and the reason is now recorded in cycle.html beside gateOn() as well as in settings.html: a stored sex field predicts less well than the person saying so, and onboarding now asks the question outright. Nothing gates on being non-female any more, by decision.
evidence: drove it — with lk_cycle unset the gate screen renders and Open Settings is the way out; setting it live flips the screen without a reload

name: Shopping-list & store helper layer (in range, not a Fuel-entry UI)
gap: The parser reads a leading quantity and unit off the typed line and says what it read before the tap. Store URLs are retailer-specific for nine of the ten shops this build offers (Walmart, Amazon, Target, Costco, Whole Foods, Kroger, Instacart, Trader Joe's, Safeway); Aldi and any shop somebody types in fall back to /search?q=, which is named as a guess rather than presented as that retailer's own. v6's count was thirteen because it carried three shops this build does not.
evidence: drove it — "2 kg chicken thighs" reads as 2 kg Chicken Thighs, "500g salmon" as 500 g Salmon, "12 eggs" as 12 Eggs, "2.5 eggs" as nothing; adding "3 kg sweet potato" stored quantity 3, unit kg

name: Per-item store deep links
evidence: drove it — every item still to get carries a chip per enabled shop (capped at three), one tap opens that shop's own search for that item, a ticked-off row loses them, and the item sheet still lists every shop. Chips are 44px; the screen audit passes.

name: Import checked shopping-list items as a pending purchase
evidence: drove it — Send 3 to Budget moved the ticked items into lk_budgetData.pendingItems and switched panel; pricing one at 9.50 with a store wrote a purchase of source "list" into the history, moved the week from $19.70 to $29.20, put the item in the pantry, left the unpriced two pending, and all of it survived a reload

name: Home header greeting, name and streak pill
gap: The time-of-day greeting and the display-name H1 stay cut, with the reason recorded in home.html's own header comment: this screen answers one question and a greeting is 60px of header that does not. The avatar initial (from lk_profile.displayName), the date and the flame streak pill are all live, the pill gated on lk_badges.
evidence: drove it — with lk_badges on and six days trained in a row the pill reads 6

name: Configurable home block layout (order + hide)
gap: Five blocks reorder and hide (feed, last session, recent, climbing, cycle) and the week band hides; the answer card does not move, because a Home whose answer has been scrolled under four other blocks has stopped answering — the reason is recorded above BLOCKS in home.html. The quick-action picker is not back: a quick action is a crossing, every crossing has to be declared in 10-final/assemble.mjs, and that file is not in this package.
evidence: drove it — the down arrow on the feed wrote lk_homeLayout.order ["last","stack","recent","climbing","cycle"], the screen repainted in that order, and the order survived a reload

name: Weekly aggregates (training days, volume, sets, cardio, consistency label)
gap: The week still starts Monday here rather than v6's Sunday: two week windows on one screen cannot disagree about the same Sunday, and the week track above the line is Monday-first. It is the one figure on this screen that deliberately differs from v6, and it differs in one place.
where: home.html buildModel weekSets/weekVol/weekCardio, home.html momentum() totals
evidence: drove it — with the seed the line reads "1 day this week · Building momentum" over "16 sets · 14,363 kg", which is the 7 Sep PPL - Legs session; a week with no cardio prints no cardio figure and the loading skeleton reserves both lines

name: Dynamic feed / supplement reminder / running-low / cycle reminder blocks
gap: Eight cards now, each gated on its own data and each dismissible to lk_homeLayout. The compounds card is still the one that cannot render: it reads lk_cycles, and nothing in the build writes that key — stack.html holds its cycles in a literal. It stays wired to the key rather than to a copy of Stack's data; stack.html is not in this package.
evidence: drove it — insight, running low and next session render off the seed; supplements due renders inside its own time window; recovery, comeback and rest day render when the stored check-ins and history say so

name: Start Workout / View Progress navigation buttons
gap: Start starts the session the card names (writes lk_startDay). VIEW PROGRESS stays cut with the reason in home.html:52 — it was a button standing in for a tab — and Progress is reached from the Climbing row, which is declared in MANIFEST.nav and carries the lift the row names.

name: Weekly Recap screen
gap: v6's "missed days" card is here as "Days without a session": the splits in this build carry no weekday, so which day was supposed to be a training day is not in the data and nothing can call a day missed. The reason is recorded in recap.html. The recap is still a row on Home rather than a block, by the rebuild's own decision (three entrances to the same history on a four-block screen).
where: recap.html viewWeek blank-days and streak cards
evidence: drove it — the seed week reads "2 of 3 — Tue, Wed" counted up to today; with lk_badges on and three days trained in a row the streak card reads 3

name: Bottom navigation bar (`Nav`)
gap: The bar works on every screen — five tabs, aria-current, scroll-minimise, and chrome.js already owns the minimise and the ResizeObserver — but it is still duplicated markup per file rather than one Nav publishing --lk-nav-h, and the active tab is hard-coded per screen. Unifying it means editing chrome.js and all sixteen screens; this package owns four of them and none of the shared modules, so it is not closable from here.
evidence: read the source; the screen audit's tab-bar check passes on all four screens in this package

name: Error recovery screens
gap: Home, Shop, Recap and Cycle now have a real boundary as well as their per-state error copy: an uncaught throw or rejection lands in the screen's own error state, which says the data is on the device and offers the one control that helps. The boundary only fires for the screen that is actually on screen, because the demo gives every screen one window. The other twelve screens and the demo shell still have none, and those files are not in this package.
where: home.html crashed/mine, shopping.html window error, recap.html window error
evidence: drove it — a thrown error on each of the three repaints that screen's error state with no console noise, and Home's Try again reloads rather than starting a workout, which is what it used to do

name: Dynamic Feed ("YOUR FEED" cards)
gap: Four of the five training cards are built — recovery, rest day, comeback and next session — each derived from lk_feedback, lk_history and lk_splits and silent when its own data says nothing. The check-in card is cut, with the reason recorded above CARD_IDS: Coach owns lk_feedback and writes all five of its scales, and reads them back with "log[0].sleep <= 2", which a null satisfies. A one-tap mood card here would make Coach offer advice about a night nobody rated.
evidence: drove it — recovery reads "Of your last 2 check-ins, 2 logged soreness at 4 or more and 2 logged sleep at 2 or less"; comeback reads "6 days since PPL - Push"; rest day reads "6 days in a row"; next session reads "Push, then Pull, then Legs" off the seed's PPL split
